integrity: The proofs and checks are provided transparently; no independent audit, external certification or publication-priority claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to 4x4 one-step weighted nilpotent shifts with positive outer weights and nonnegative middle weight, up to unitary phase adjustments. General numerical-shadow moment and equivalence criteria, as well as non-rigidity of nilpotency/rank, are prior work; the new contribution is the exact per-fiber operator- and Schatten-four norm ranges and global sharp paired distortion constants. Unindexed prior overlap and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Golden-ratio and fourth-Schatten distortion inside four-site numerical-shadow fibers
